notes: SwarmPepes is the accepted fixed-supply ERC-20 in src/SwarmPepes.sol. Its argument-free constructor mints 1,000,000,000 SPEPE with 18 decimals entirely to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It has no public mint or burn functions, transfer taxes, owner, or administrative controls. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs with the requested ERC-20 at a 0.3% fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed as paired-currency minor units per SPEPE minor unit with SPEPE as currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply using the deployed currency ordering.
